## All Posts

Below is a condensed list of all posts grouped by year and month.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

# Gather all post index files
files <- list.files("posts", pattern = "index.qmd", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)

get_meta <- function(f) {
  lines <- readLines(f, warn = FALSE)
  idx <- which(grepl("^---\\s*$", lines))
  if (length(idx) >= 2) {
    fm <- lines[(idx[1] + 1):(idx[2] - 1)]
    title_line <- fm[grepl("^title\\s*:", fm)][1]
    date_line <- fm[grepl("^date\\s*:", fm)][1]
    title <- if (!is.na(title_line)) sub('^title\\s*:\\s*', '', title_line) else basename(dirname(f))
    title <- gsub('^\\s*["]|["]\\s*$', '', title)
    date_str <- if (!is.na(date_line)) sub('^date\\s*:\\s*', '', date_line) else NA
    date_str <- gsub('^\\s*["\']|["\']\\s*$', '', date_str)
    date <- if (!is.na(date_str) && nzchar(date_str)) as.Date(date_str) else NA
  } else {
    title <- basename(dirname(f))
    date <- NA
  }
  slug <- basename(dirname(f))
  list(title = title, date = date, slug = slug)
}

posts <- lapply(files, get_meta)
posts_df <- data.frame(
  title = sapply(posts, `[[`, "title"),
  date = as.Date(sapply(posts, function(x) as.character(x$date))),
  slug = sapply(posts, `[[`, "slug"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Exclude template directory
posts_df <- posts_df[posts_df$slug != "_post-template", , drop = FALSE]

# Order by date desc
posts_df <- posts_df[order(posts_df$date, decreasing = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]

years <- unique(format(posts_df$date, "%Y"))
years <- years[!is.na(years)]
years <- sort(years, decreasing = TRUE)

for (y in years) {
  cat(sprintf("\n### %s\n\n", y))
  sub <- posts_df[format(posts_df$date, "%Y") == y, , drop = FALSE]
  months <- unique(format(sub$date, "%m"))
  months <- months[order(as.integer(months), decreasing = TRUE)]
  for (mm in months) {
    month_name <- month.name[as.integer(mm)]
    cat(sprintf("\n#### %s\n\n", month_name))
    subm <- sub[format(sub$date, "%m") == mm, , drop = FALSE]
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(subm))) {
      row <- subm[i, ]
      # Emit a heading for each post so it appears in the page TOC
      cat(sprintf("##### [%s](posts/%s/)\n\n", row$title, row$slug))
    }
    cat("\n")
  }
}
```
